title: Claude — Motion Reel 2026
topic: A 15-second motion design showreel demonstrating range: kinetic type, variable type, 3D, systems, particles, interface, fluid
style: Editorial reel. Ink #08080A, bone #F2EEE6, one hot accent #FF4A1C, violet rim light #7B6CFF. Inter variable 100–900, italic serif asides. Hard cuts on a 120 BPM grid, velocity-driven directional blur, timecode HUD and crop marks.

scenes.title: 01 Kinetic
scenes.description: MOTION slams in letter by letter on eighth notes, each with a different mechanic and velocity blur. Accent bar wipe exits.

scenes.title: 02 Type
scenes.description: Bone background. BREATHE: a weight and tracking wave rolls through the letters. Italic serif aside. Slice-mask exit.

scenes.title: 03 Depth
scenes.description: Chrome torus knot and satellites under studio reflections, violet and orange rim lights. DEPTH sits behind and in front of the object.

scenes.title: 04 Systems
scenes.description: A 16×9 tile grid. A radial wave turns squares into circles and flips them to the accent color.

scenes.title: 05 Particles
scenes.description: Thousands of points morph from a sphere into the word FLOW, then burst outward.

scenes.title: 06 Interface
scenes.description: Perspective UI cards stack in. A line chart draws, a counter climbs, a cursor clicks.

scenes.title: 07 Fluid
scenes.description: Gooey accent metaballs orbit, merge and collapse into one dot.

scenes.title: 08 Signature
scenes.description: The dot opens to black. CLAUDE, Motion Designer, discipline index, accent underline hit, hold.
